articles.summary: I'm happy to announce that AuthZed recently renewed our SOC2 compliance and our SOC2 Type 2 and SOC3 reports are now available on security.authzed.com. Having just endured the audit process again, I figured it would be a good time to reflect on my personal feelings toward compliance and how my opinion has evolved.
articles.title: Our SOC2 Renewal and Reflections on Compliance

articles.summary: DeepSeek has emerged as a phenomenon since its announcement in late December 2024 and security has been at the forefront of recent conversation. At AuthZed, we recognize that trust and security fundamentally shape how organizations evaluate AI models, which is why we're sharing our perspective on this crucial discussion.
articles.title: DeepSeek: Balancing Potential and Precaution with SpiceDB

articles.summary: The dual-write problem is present in any distributed system and is difficult to solve. We discuss where the problem arises and several approaches.
articles.title: The Dual-Write Problem
